# Mid-Handoff Duplicate Doorbell

This scenario forces a non-terminal handoff before final. Duplicate doorbells may fire while the next agent is active.

context: You are testing duplicate-doorbell resilience under v2. A duplicate doorbell may fire for the same latest state while a peer turn is active. Respond to each requested turn exactly once by writing one completed outbox file. Required flow: Claude first asks Codex to confirm duplicate-doorbell handling; Codex writes exactly one confirmation; Claude then writes final. The final answer should mention mid-handoff duplicate doorbell resilience.
